job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Primitives
job.location: New York, NY or Austin, TX
job.pay_full: $185,000 – $231,000 estimated annual salary for New York City hires, plus eligibility for Cloudflare's equity plan

details.about: Cloudflare runs one of the world's largest networks, protecting and speeding up millions of websites and internet properties. Its Workers team lets customers run JavaScript and WebAssembly on Cloudflare's edge network, handling trillions of requests a month. Within Workers, the Data Primitives group brings state to the edge: it builds and operates D1 (a managed SQLite database), Queues (messaging) and Workers KV (a global low-latency key-value store), and designs new services for customers' application integration needs. You would join the D1, Queues or Workers KV team.
duties: Keep D1, Queues or Workers KV and customers' applications running smoothly at global scale
Build new features, improve reliability and raise performance
Own your code from first idea to release, across every layer of the stack
Write and review design documents, change how a service processes and stores data, and fix bugs, including in the user experience
Mentor and guide engineers who are early in their careers
Work with languages and technologies including TypeScript, Go, Rust and C++
needs: 5+ years of experience with distributed systems and data
Solid understanding of TypeScript and Go, including asynchronous programming in both
Strong systems-level programming skills and an understanding of security issues
Experience monitoring, alerting on and debugging high-volume production systems
Continuous integration, source control (git) and solid Linux experience
Fluency analysing data sets such as logs, and designing and building APIs
Strong spoken and written communication, a willingness to share knowledge and mentor, and a desire to keep learning
details.benefits: Estimated annual salary for NYC-based hires: $185,000 – $231,000 (compensation may be adjusted by work location). The role is eligible for Cloudflare's equity plan. US benefits include medical/Rx, dental and vision insurance, flexible and commuter spending accounts, fertility and family-forming benefits, on-demand mental health support and an employee assistance program, global travel medical insurance, short- and long-term disability, life and accident insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, an employee stock participation plan, flexible paid time off for vacation and sick leave, and leave programs including parental, pregnancy health, medical and bereavement leave.
notes: The posting lists its skills and experience as desirable examples rather than strict requirements
Hybrid role; US locations listed are New York City and Austin (the posting publishes a US salary range for NYC-based hires)
Candidates who reach the offer stage may be asked to attend an in-person interview at a Cloudflare office or hub
The position may require access to information covered by US export control laws; an offer may depend on authorization to receive it without an export licence
Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities
